children: AIG closed the sale of €625,000,000 of 4.250% Notes due 2031 and €500,000,000 of 4.750% Notes due 2036.
Issued €1.125 billion aggregate principal across two Euro-denominated note series to refinance or fund operations.
Notes carry fixed coupons: 4.250% for 2031 maturities and 4.750% for 2036, setting long-term borrowing costs.
Transaction supported by an underwriting group led by Deutsche Bank, J.P. Morgan, BNP Paribas and Citigroup.
Related documents filed: underwriting agreement, supplemental indentures, note forms and counsel opinion.
